mainEntity.name: Do you offer 24/7 emergency HVAC service?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We answer calls 24 hours a day, 7 days a week — including weekends and holidays. A live dispatcher will get a licensed tech to you fast.

mainEntity.name: What areas of New Jersey do you serve?

acceptedAnswer.text: We're based in Woodland Park and serve a 25-mile radius covering Passaic, Bergen, Morris, Hudson, Union, and Essex Counties.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer financing for new HVAC systems?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — we offer 24 months of 0% interest financing through Synchrony Bank on qualifying AC, furnace, and tankless water heater installations.

mainEntity.name: How quickly can you come out for an AC repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: For most calls in Passaic County we offer same-day service. Emergencies typically get a tech on-site within 2 hours.
Yes. We're a fully licensed New Jersey contractor and carry full liability and workers' comp insurance.

mainEntity.name: What HVAC brands do you service?

acceptedAnswer.text: All major brands including Carrier, Trane, Lennox, Bryant, Goodman, Rheem, Mitsubishi, and more.

ABOUT US
North Jersey's HVAC & Plumbing Champions

For over 35 years, Service Champions has kept Woodland Park families warm in winter, cool in summer, and dry the rest of the year.

Our Story

Service Champions was built on a simple promise: do the work right, charge a fair price, and treat every customer like family. That promise has carried us through more than three decades of North Jersey weather, code changes, and equipment evolution.

We started as a small plumbing operation and grew into a full-service HVAC and plumbing company because our customers kept asking us to handle more for them. Today, we install and service every kind of heating, cooling, and plumbing system across Passaic, Bergen, Morris, Hudson, Union, and Essex Counties — but we're still the same neighborhood shop at heart.

Our techs are NJ-licensed, factory-trained, and held to a standard most companies have given up on: show up on time, explain what's happening in plain English, and never sell anyone something they don't need.

CERTIFICATIONS & AWARDS
A Trusted Rheem Pro Partner

Service Champions is a factory-authorized Rheem Pro Partner and was named a 2025 Rheem Difference Maker — recognition reserved for the top-performing HVAC and plumbing contractors in the country.

RHEEM PRO PARTNER

Factory-authorized installation & service

Pro Partners pass strict training, insurance, and customer-satisfaction requirements set by Rheem.

2025 DIFFERENCE MAKER

A top-tier Rheem contractor

Awarded to contractors who go above and beyond on craftsmanship and customer experience.

What Sets Us Apart
35+ Years of Experience

Three decades of service across North Jersey homes — from century-old Paterson row homes to brand-new Wayne colonials.

Licensed & Insured

Fully licensed and insured. Full liability and workers' comp insurance on every job.

Locally Owned

We live and work in Woodland Park. Our customers are our neighbors, and we treat every home like our own.

Family-Style Service

Real people answer our phones. Real techs show up on time. No call centers, no gimmicks.
